purpose: Teach: 戰/燈/會/茵/繭/狭間/のっとっ/云い

lines.speaker: saito_doctor
lines.jp: 蓮さん、旧字「戰」、つまり戦争関連の精神医学的影響を医療チームで研究します
lines.en: Ren, our medical team will be researching the psychiatric impacts of warfare using old-form characters as a conceptual framework.
lines.style: Clear, measured clinical tone. Direct eye contact. Steady pace. Professional distance maintained but not cold. The weight of the subject matter beneath the composure.

lines.speaker: saito_doctor
lines.jp: 蓮さん、旧字「燈」、つまり灯の使用での火傷症例を医療チームで治療します
lines.en: Ren, we'll be treating burn cases related to traditional lamp use — our team will be managing these cases with specialized care.
lines.style: Same measured pace as before. Slight pause before the practical detail. Clinical but grounded. No rush to the explanation.

lines.speaker: saito_doctor
lines.jp: 蓮さん、旧字「會」、つまり会議体での医療連携を医療チームで強化します
lines.en: Ren, we're strengthening medical coordination across hospital committees — it's something our team is actively reinforcing.
lines.style: Confident on the word 'strengthening.' Organizational, purposeful. Still calm. A hint that this matters beyond the immediate conversation.

lines.speaker: saito_doctor
lines.jp: 蓮さん、医療用の茵、つまり茵席、ベッドマットの選定を医療チームでおこないます
lines.en: Ren, we're going to be selecting specialized mattress materials for medical use — our team will handle that process.
lines.style: Slight shift to the practical and concrete. Still composed but more grounded. A brief softening on 'specialized' — acknowledging the care behind the detail.

lines.speaker: saito_doctor
lines.jp: 蓮さん、養蚕の繭由来のシルク医療材料を医療チームで研究します
lines.en: Ren, our medical team is researching silk-based materials derived from sericulture for therapeutic applications.
lines.style: Renewed clinical focus. Gentle interest entering the tone — this is new territory. Still measured but with a slight forward lean in the rhythm.

lines.speaker: saito_doctor
lines.jp: 蓮さん、山の狭間での救急搬送を医療チームで整えます
lines.en: Ren, we're putting emergency transport protocols in place for mountainous areas — our team is organizing the logistics.
lines.style: Practical urgency without panic. Steady and decisive. The word 'organizing' carries a note of careful preparation. No wasted breath.

lines.speaker: saito_doctor
lines.jp: 蓮さん、医療倫理にのっとっ、つまり則って診療します
lines.en: Ren, we conduct our care according to medical ethics — that's the foundation we work from.
lines.style: Quieter, more personal. A statement of principle. Slow on 'ethics.' The conviction is quiet but unmistakable. Eye contact deepens.

lines.speaker: saito_doctor
lines.jp: 蓮さん、患者様の云い、つまり「云いたい事」を医療チームで丁寧に聴きます
lines.en: Ren, our medical team listens carefully to what patients actually want to say — we take that seriously.
lines.style: Noticeably softer than the opening lines. Slower pace. Warmth surfaces beneath the clinical register. A gentle close, almost intimate. Slight trailing breath.
